newsitem.title: FRANCE: Cie des Signaux up on Thomson bid talk.
newsitem.headline: Cie des Signaux up on Thomson bid talk.

text.p: Shares in electronics firm Compagnie des Signaux rose sharply against the trend on Monday on a newspaper report that it might join with Lagardere Groupe in a bid for defence electronics firm Thomson-CSF, brokers said.
Compagnie des Signaux officials declined to comment on the report. The share was up 3.63 percent at 305.80 francs at 1500 GMT while the market's CAC-40 index was down 1.6 percent.
La Tribune said Lagardere was eager to line up Compagnie des Signaux chairman Yazid Sabeg, who is close to both its Matra unit and to rival Thomson bidder Alcatel Alsthom.

Sabeg said in an interview on February 27 that he hoped the Thomson-CSF privatisation would bring all the defence electronics players together. He declined to express a preference between the Alcatel and Lagardere bids but said bringing Thomson and Matra was logical and natural.
Compagnie des Signaux purchased Lagardere Matra Securite at the end of 1995.
